summary: This directory defines the core TypeScript schemas for JSDoc and TSDoc parsing, analysis, and management. It provides structured representations for raw comments, parsed tags, documentation quality metrics, human-edit signals, and protected documentation regions.
responsibilities: Defining schema structures for JSDoc/TSDoc metadata and content
Modeling parsed documentation tags and block structures
Representing analysis metrics for documentation quality
Identifying protected code regions and sections within documentation
Tracking manual human modifications to generated documentation
relationships: ParsedJsDoc aggregates individual tag structures like JsDocParam, JsDocReturns, and JsDocThrows.
JsDocAnalysis utilizes human edit signals to determine the modification state of documentation.
RawJsDoc acts as the source for generating ParsedJsDoc structures.
ProtectedRegion and ProtectedSection define constraints on which documentation parts remain immutable during generation.
designDecisions: Strong typing using TypeScript schemas to ensure structural consistency for parsed documentation
Separation of concerns between raw comment content and structured parsed metadata
Inclusion of metadata for change tracking and protection to support automated documentation workflows
